body_markdown:
Hafnia has been named Tanker Operator of the Year at the 24th ShipTek International Awards Singapore 2026, winning the award for the second consecutive year.


The jury acknowledged Hafnia’s well-established international presence, integrated operating platform and consistent focus on safety, efficiency, and responsible fleet management. “


*Its continued emphasis on operational performance, sustainability and long-term value creation reflects the qualities expected from a leading tanker operator. This recognition celebrates Hafnia’s ability to combine scale, expertise and disciplined operations while continuing to contribute positively to the advancement of the tanker shipping industry” remarked the jury.*


The ShipTek International Awards held annually in Singapore, recognizes excellence and innovation across the maritime, oil and gas, and offshore industries. The awards celebrate organizations and individuals that demonstrate outstanding performance, leadership, and contribution to industry advancement. Across 24 organizational categories and five individual honours, the awards recognized achievements in shipping, ship management, offshore services, technology, training and sustainability.


Hafnia thanks its team onshore and at sea for their efforts, the ShipTek awards jury for the recognition and extends our congratulations to the other award recipients.
